text:
miri: Heads up  NimbusCloud sent a draft solution brief + marketplace tile and asked for a joint webinar mention on the listing. Can marketing confirm logo usage and the quote?

dylan-marketing: Got it. Do they want full-color or white-on-dark for the hero? Need their logo files + permission PDF.

jade (NimbusCloud): We prefer full-color horizontal for the hero on white, white-on-dark for social. We'll upload logo SVG/PNG and a signed brand permission doc. Our guideline: 12px clearspace, no rotation, don't place on busy photos.

sam-eng: Note: brief references a "2x latency improvement" in our test. Ops/legal will want the test appendix or non-numeric language. Marketplace often flags raw numbers.

miri: Let's avoid raw numbers in the public brief. Draft quote suggestion: "Redwood + NimbusCloud delivered faster inference with more consistent latency." Jade ok with that?

jade (NimbusCloud): That's fine. Nimbus legal asks to change "faster" to "noticeably faster" or provide test notes. They also request the one-line quote be no more than 120 characters.

dylan-marketing: I'll tighten it: "Redwood + NimbusCloud delivered noticeably faster inference and improved cost predictability." That stays under 120 chars.

ops-amy: Asset specs for marketplace: hero 1200x628 PNG (sRGB, no alpha), square tile 600x600, social 1200x1200. We also need a 400x160 hero for the partner portal. Please provide SVG lockup (unmodified) and a PNG with white background for CMS.

jade (NimbusCloud): Uploading now: nimbus-logo.svg, nimbus-logo-600.png, nimbus-permission-signed.pdf. All in shared drive -> partners/nimbus/asset-pack. SVG must not be edited per our trademark rules.

legal-bot: Reminder: attach the permission PDF to #legal-approvals. Performance claims require a test appendix (spreadsheet + params) or use non-numeric wording. Moving reference to #legal-approvals (ref 1790022334).

sam-eng: If we want a quantitative appendix, we need to include instance types, input distribution, and prompts. That takes a few days. Recommend non-numeric phrasing for launch.

dylan-marketing: Agreed. I'll remove the 2x stat and replace the benchmark image on page 4 with an architecture diagram. Also will create a partner quote image (logo + one-line quote) sized 1200x628 and a square 600x600 for the marketplace tile.

miri: Webinar note: Nimbus is open to a joint webinar in early June. Let's draft a co-host blurb but don't publish it on the marketplace tile until webinar date is locked.

jade (NimbusCloud): We'll have our PM share dates by EOD Friday. Also request we use Nimbus blue (#0A74D1) for any partner callouts to keep brand consistency.

ops-amy: Quick nit: please export PNGs with sRGB profile and no alpha, avoid placing Nimbus logo over hero photography, use a solid bar for contrast if needed.

dylan-marketing: Copy that. I'll drop the new PNGs into partners/nimbus/final and ping ops + legal when ready. Target publish w/marketplace tile the week after webinar if all signoffs complete.

legal-bot: Logged. Moving nimbus-permission-signed.pdf to #legal-approvals for verification (ref 1790022334).

miri: Thanks everyone  action items: dylan -> export hero/tile/social PNGs and quote image; jade -> confirm webinar dates and confirm permission doc; sam -> ensure architecture diagram replaces numeric benchmark; ops-amy -> verify final thumbnails two business days before publish.

dylan-marketing: On it. Will update thread with links when assets are uploaded. :rocket:
